news.title: Le marché des Enfants-Rouges, à Paris, "ravagé" par un incendie
news.summary: Un feu a "ravagé" le marché des Enfants-Rouges, situé au cœur de la capitale, a annoncé la mairie de Paris Centre tôt lundi matin. Il s'agit du plus vieux marché couvert de Paris
news.credit_fr: D'après l'actualité du 12 octobre : Le marché des Enfants-Rouges, à Paris, "ravagé" par un incendie (France 24)
news.mechanic_fr: Un incendie important déclenche des contrôles de sécurité qui peuvent forcer des petits cafés à fermer pour travaux.
news.entry_fr: La journaliste dit la nouvelle au zinc et demande directement à l'héritier·ère ce qu'il pense de Solvel.

plate.brief: a city inspector's clipboard on the counter, Light: grey afternoon, wet reflections on the sidewalk, weather: steady rain

pick.mechanic_fr: Un incendie majeur dans un marché parisien déclenche des contrôles de sécurité et des fermetures administratives temporaires pour les bistrots et marchés couverts du quartier, pouvant forcer Le Mistral à fermer pour travaux.
pick.why: A nearby blaze would trigger safety inspections that could threaten the café’s immediate future and force the group to act.
pick.say_it_fr: Le marché des Enfants‑Rouges a été ravagé par un incendie ce matin et la mairie lance des contrôles qui pourraient faire fermer des petits cafés comme le Mistral.

draft.premise_fr: Le zinc est plein: Gus et Marin plaisantent. Romy interroge Margaux, puis elle se retourne vers toi: elle sait que Solvel achète des bistrots. La mairie lance des contrôles après un grand feu au marché; ces contrôles peuvent forcer Le Mistral à fermer pour travaux. Romy veut savoir qui tu es et ce que tu penses de Solvel.
draft.setup_native: Romy asks who you are and what you think of Solvel, after a news report that could force small cafés like Le Mistral to close.
draft.objective_native: In one short sentence, tell Romy who you are and whether you trust Solvel.
draft.objective_semantics: The learner must introduce themself as Odile's heir (or not) and give a brief opinion about Solvel (trust / worry). One sentence, simple vocabulary, at most two clauses.
draft.causal_reason: A big fire at a central market triggers safety checks; Romy worries the same checks could close Le Mistral, so she asks the learner directly.

chapter.dramatic_question: Vas-tu dire à Romy qui tu es, et que tu penses de Solvel ?
possible_developments: Romy records your answer and uses it in her story, changing how the quartier sees you.
Margaux reacts, and the learner becomes publicly known as Odile's heir.
Gus makes a show of defending the café, escalating the attention from Solvel.

panels.narration_fr: La radio a dit le matin : un grand marché a brûlé. Les contrôles commencent.
panels.visual_direction: Wide shot of the café interior. Gus straightens salt cellars at the booth; Marin carries a bowl of soup from the kitchen. Margaux stands behind the zinc, a pair of pliers on the counter.
panels.alt_native: Inside the café: Gus at the booth, Marin with soup, Margaux behind the counter.

panels.visual_direction: Close-up on Margaux as she slides a small pair of pliers across the zinc to Gus; the cicada keyring is visible. No dialogue from the learner.
panels.alt_native: Margaux pushes pliers across the counter; she looks at Gus.

dialogue.text_fr: Le marché des Enfants‑Rouges a été ravagé par un incendie ce matin et la mairie lance des contrôles qui pourraient faire fermer des petits cafés comme le Mistral.
dialogue.text_native: The Marché des Enfants‑Rouges was ravaged by a fire this morning and the city is launching checks that could force small cafés like Le Mistral to close.

dialogue.text_fr: C'est toi l'héritage ? Et que penses-tu de Solvel ?
dialogue.text_native: Are you the heir? And what do you think of Solvel?

panels.visual_direction: Medium shot: Romy leans on the counter, camera strap visible, voice low but direct as she turns to you.
panels.alt_native: Romy speaks to the learner at the counter, mentioning the fire and asking a question.

panels.visual_direction: Panel without dialogue: a close-up on the learner's hands on the zinc; other customers look briefly at you. The café's neon glows through the window.
panels.alt_native: Close-up of the learner's hands on the counter, with the café neon visible.

panels.visual_direction: Medium shot: Gus gives a small, theatrical bow toward the learner; Marin waits with the soup. Romy watches, pen ready but respectful, leaving space for your answer.
panels.alt_native: Gus gestures theatrically; Marin holds a bowl. Romy listens with a pen.

draft.opening_line_fr: C'est toi l'héritage ? Et que penses-tu de Solvel ?
draft.suggested_response_fr: Je suis l'héritier d'Odile et je pense que Solvel menace les cafés de quartier.
draft.hint_native: Say one short sentence: introduce yourself as Odile's heir (or not) and give a simple opinion about Solvel (trust or worry). Keep it honest but brief.
draft.translation_native: Are you the heir? And what do you think of Solvel?

season_checklist.change_before: Romy did not know who you were or your view of Solvel.
season_checklist.change_after: Romy asks you directly and the café waits for your answer; your position can become public.
season_checklist.turn_want: Tell Romy who you are and whether you trust Solvel.
season_checklist.complication: The city controls may force temporary closure of small cafés like Le Mistral tomorrow.

refusals.hint: A A2 learner answers in one sentence: ask for ONE thing (at most 2 clause separator(s) and 24 words). "Tell Romy, briefly, who you are and what you think of Solvel  ." chains 4 asks.

draft.dramatic_question: Vas-tu dire la vérité à Romy, et la laisser décider de son angle ?
draft.objective_native: Tell Romy, briefly, who you are and what you think of Solvel (one or two short sentences).

refusals.hint: Romy says «tu» to the learner in this season, but here says «vous»: «C'est vous, l'héritage ?». Rewrite Romy's lines with tu (tu, toi, ton, ta): from someone who knows the learner, a «vous» reads as a stranger's. Keep the narration's address the same as theirs.

draft.dramatic_question: Qui êtes‑vous pour Odile, et pouvez‑vous dire ce que vous pensez de Solvel sans blesser Margaux ?
draft.objective_native: Tell Romy who you are and give a short opinion about Solvel (one or two short sentences).

refusals.hint: Today is a news day, but news_line_fr is not on the page. Put the news ON THE PAGE: one line of narration or dialogue that says what happened in simple words (name it: the fire, the strike, the record), make today's scene turn on its consequence, and copy that line exactly into news_day_notes.news_line_fr. Say it like this: «Le marché des Enfants‑Rouges a été ravagé par un incendie ce matin et la mairie lance des contrôles qui pourraient faire fermer des petits cafés comme le Mistral.».

draft.dramatic_question: Vas-tu te montrer comme l'héritier qui défend le Mistral, ou rester neutre ?
